Messages.Author: Stephen Beaulieu
Messages.Body:
Welcome Yaz-
The Mask allows the vampire with sup. Obf. taking over the action to
continue the action at +1 stealth. The card is an action modifier and so
cannot be blocked.
Hope this helps.
stephen

Welcome aboard!

>To avoid any further arguments (we have plenty as it

superior
>level. Basically, it says: as above but with +1 stealth. So, my question
>is: does it means the action continues at +1 stealth or do you get +1
stealth
>to play the card?

The only thing you can intercept is an action. The Mask is an action
modifier, so it cannot be intercepted and stealth is not meaningful. The
stealth is added to that of the original action.

Messages.Author: Joseph Cochran
Messages.Body:
In article <D6tzE...@torfree.net>, Jasminka Sostar <ai...@torfree.net> wrote:
>in my playing group. To avoid any further arguments (we have plenty as it
>is), I would like a clariffication for the Mask of 1000 Faces at the superior
>level. Basically, it says: as above but with +1 stealth. So, my question
>is: does it means the action continues at +1 stealth or do you get +1 stealth
>to play the card?

All action modifiers lend bonuses to actions, so the Mask gives
+1 stealth to whatever action is currently taking place. To forestall
any other arguments in your group, note that Mask can also end up making
a vampire perform an action which may otherwise be illegal (for example,
a vampire with Animalism may try to call an Army of Rats, and through
use of the Mask, a vampire with superior Obfuscate and no Animalism may
end up being the one who calls the action).
